name: Call Jenny

hint: Look at the badge icon closely. What is Jenny’s number?
solution: Check if 000 is on the board. If it is, spell 8-6-7-5-3-0-9. After the telephone cue and “Hello”, beat the level.

name: Easter Egg Barrage
how: Don Quixote would find the egg and win the level
hint: Put all your eggs in one basket!
solution: Beat the level while scoring all hoops on one basket, then score on the flashing basket.

name: Easter Egg Flip
how: Find the egg, win the level
hint: What level has an egg, and what can you do with it?
solution: Match the panel with the egg first, then beat the level.

name: Easter Egg Mega Grid
how: Find the egg, win the level
hint: The egg is not obtained during the actual game itself. When else can you get it?
solution: Before the game starts an egg briefly appears on a panel. Press it, then win the level.

name: Easter Egg Numbers
how: Level the win, egg the find.
hint: Read the description for the badge. What is different?
solution: Hit the numbers from highest to lowest, then hit the panel with the egg. Beat the level normally.

name: Easter Egg Statues
how: Find the egg, win the level
solution: During a round, one panel will not show a timer while the others do. Press it, then win the level.

name: Easter Egg Stopwatch
how: Find the egg, win the level
hint: What game elements are used in Stopwatch? Which ones aren’t?
solution: At the start, press the panel that is draining down before it fully drains, then win the level.

name: Easter Egg Trivial
how: Find the egg, win the level
hint: What question would have an Easter Egg?
solution: When asked “Which of these is not associated with Easter?”, answer “Egg” and score on the flashing basket. Then answer “Tree” and finish the level.
tip: The required question does not appear every attempt.

name: Easter Egg Words
how: Find the egg, win the level
hint: When you’re prompted for the egg, what else can you spell instead?
solution: When the first word is EASTER, spell EGG, collect the egg on a random panel, then spell EASTER normally and win.
tip: The EASTER prompt must be the first word, per the source as of Feb 2026.

name: Riddle 1.0
how: With the sign all lit up, search the screen for the cup.
hint: What sign isn’t already lit up? How can you light it up?
solution: Sign in 5 players to a room sign-in screen, then check each game’s How To Play screen. When you see a trophy icon, click it. Its location changes daily.

name: Riddle 2.0
how: Looking for stars while taking a break, look no further and click the mistake
hint: “Stars” is a bit outdated. What would you use while taking a break that you could click on?
solution: On the score checker iPad, go to Stats and click “Looses” in “Number of Looses”. It changes to “Losses” and awards the badge.

name: Riddle 3.0
how: Mary had a little lamb, little lamb, little lamb. Mary had a little lamb, its fleece was white as snow.
hint: Where could you play Mary Had A Little Lamb?
solution: Click the badge trophies on the score checker. They make different pitches. Play Mary Had A Little Lamb on the trophies in the correct order.

name: Riddle 4.0
how: Within one second of signing into a game, exit the score checker and this badge you will claim.
hint: The description is mostly self-explanatory. How would you exit the score checker?
solution: Scan your wristband on any sign-in screen, then click Sign Out on the score checker within 1 second.

name: Riddle 5.0
how: Two may be missing, but there’s still twenty-four. Choose them in order, and forget about your score.
hint: What game has twenty-four, with two missing? That would add up to 26.
solution: Pass the ball through all pipes in alphabetical order, skipping X and Z, then finish the level.

name: Riddle 6.0
how: When the timer starts to run, in the first stage of level 1, go tick tock around the clock, giving all the buttons a knock
hint: In what game can you easily do this without instantly losing?
solution: In the first wave, start on the left edge and hit all blue buttons in clockwise order, then beat the level.

name: Riddle 7.0
how: Winning Activate level 7s can cause a lot of stress, now do it back to back in all games that start with S.
hint: There is no specific order, but the challenge is that it is very difficult.
solution: Go to each cooperative game at your facility beginning with S and beat level 7 of all of them in a row.
